title: USGS 3DEP Bare Earth DEM (pilot AOI clip)
dataDate: seamless (see service serviceDescription; compiled as of the service's latest publish date)
coverage: Clipped to bbox [-73.75992, 40.91154, -73.70373, 40.97938] (WGS84) around Village of Mamaroneck, NY
limitations: Bare-earth DEM; does not resolve sub-pixel drainage infrastructure.
Exported at 10 m via bilinear resampling from the service's native seamless resolution, not raw LiDAR point density.

title: NLCD 2021 Land Cover (pilot AOI clip)
coverage: Clipped to bbox [-73.75992, 40.91154, -73.70373, 40.97938] (WGS84) around Village of Mamaroneck, NY
resolution: 30 m/pixel, Anderson Level II land-cover classes
limitations: 30 m resolution is coarser than the 250 m analysis grid but coarser than 10 m DEM; classes generalize mixed-use parcels.

title: NLCD 2021 Percent Developed Imperviousness (pilot AOI clip)
coverage: Clipped to bbox [-73.75992, 40.91154, -73.70373, 40.97938] (WGS84) around Village of Mamaroneck, NY
limitations: 2021 snapshot; does not reflect construction after that date.

title: FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer — Flood Hazard Zones (pilot AOI clip)
dataDate: Effective DFIRM panel dates vary by zone; see per-feature DFIRM_ID/SOURCE_CIT
coverage: Clipped to bbox [-73.75992, 40.91154, -73.70373, 40.97938] (WGS84) around Village of Mamaroneck, NY (574 zone polygons)
resolution: Vector polygons, effective FEMA mapping scale
limitations: Context/predictor layer only — never used as the training label the model reproduces (per project spec).
Represents mapped riverine/coastal hazard as of the effective panel date; does not capture all local pluvial (rain-driven) flooding.

title: Global Flood Database v1 — real satellite-observed flood events (pilot AOI region)
provider: Tellman et al. 2021 / Global Flood Database, via Google Earth Engine public catalog
dataDate: 2000-2018 (913 total events in the source dataset; see per-event timeStart/timeEnd)
resolution: ~250 m/pixel (MODIS-derived), downloaded at 250 m to match the analysis grid
license: See Global Flood Database terms (research/public use); attribution required
limitations: Satellite-observed inundation only — cloud/vegetation obscured cells are excluded via clear_perc, not treated as non-flooded.
Permanent water (jrc_perm_water) must be excluded from both positive and negative training examples.
Event footprints for this small pilot AOI may cover only part of it; per-event, per-cell completeness must be checked before training (see docs/TRAINING_DATA_AUDIT.md).
MODIS-derived — coarser native resolution than the 250 m analysis grid suggests; do not oversell spatial precision.

title: Derived road/facility/intersection exposure joins (from real OSM data)
coverage: Pilot AOI (Mamaroneck, NY): 3407 road segments, 27 facilities, 4031 derived intersection candidates
resolution: Vector, real OSM geometry; intersections are a heuristic (nodes shared by >=2 ways, including non-vehicle highway classes like footways) not an authoritative traffic-engineering dataset
limitations: Intersection derivation over-counts pedestrian/footway crossings as junctions; treat as a coarse candidate list, not authoritative.

title: New York State boundary (generalized)
resolution: Generalized to ~200 m for use as a coverage mask, not a legal boundary
limitations: Generalized geometry — not for legal/parcel boundary determinations.

title: OpenStreetMap roads, public facilities, and surface water (pilot AOI)
coverage: bbox (s,w,n,e) 40.911535,-73.759915,40.979378,-73.703734 around Village of Mamaroneck, NY
limitations: Crowd-sourced; completeness and tagging accuracy vary by feature and area.

title: Global Flood Database v1 — real satellite-observed flood events (all of NY State)
provider: Tellman et al. 2021 / Global Flood Database, via Google Earth Engine public catalog
dataDate: 2000-2018 (913 total events in the source dataset)
coverage: 33 of 33 real events intersecting all of New York State (clipped to the real state boundary)
resolution: 500 m/pixel (downsampled from ~250 m native for statewide storage size)
license: See Global Flood Database terms (research/public use); attribution required
limitations: 500 m storage resolution here vs 250 m for the original pilot-only pull — coarser than the analysis grid; sampled via nearest-neighbor into the 100 m grid.
Same satellite-observation-quality caveats as the pilot pull: cloud/vegetation-obscured cells excluded via clear_perc, permanent water excluded via jrc_perm_water.

title: USDA NRCS hydrologic soil group (SSURGO, via Soil Data Access), live per-tile
provider: USDA Natural Resources Conservation Service, Soil Data Access (SDA)
dataDate: current SSURGO/gSSURGO certified soil survey data as served by SDA
coverage: Statewide New York, resolved at each tile's real centroid point (soil mapunit polygons are coarser than the ~100 m analysis grid, so one real point sample is applied tile-wide)
resolution: Mapunit polygon (variable, typically much larger than 100 m); one representative point per tile
limitations: Tile-centroid sampling, not per-cell -- a documented simplification, not per-cell soil variation.
Dense urban/built-up mapunits are often unclassified in SSURGO; real gap surfaced as a missing factor (lower confidence), never fabricated.
Dual drained/undrained classes (e.g. A/D) resolved to the conservative (undrained) letter since actual drainage status is unknown.
